run_timm_training_hpu: run a pytorch timm model training script on Intel Gaudi2 HPU devices with lazy mode
run_train_one_epoch: run one epoch of model training with gradient accumulation and HPU mark_step synchronization
run_validate_model: run validation on a trained model and compute loss, top1, and top5 accuracy metrics
run_parse_args: run the argument parser to load YAML config and CLI arguments for training setup
run_cleanup_distributed: run cleanup to destroy the distributed process group after training completes
